properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g. https://app.buyology.com,https://ops.buyology.com).

properties.name: outbox.poll-interval-ms
properties.description: How often (in milliseconds) the outbox publisher job polls for PENDING events.

properties.name: location.retention-days
properties.description: Number of days to retain courier location history before the cleanup job purges old rows.

properties.name: location.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the location history cleanup job (Spring cron format).

properties.name: auth.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for signing and verifying courier-issued JWTs. Must be at least 32 characters. Override AUTH_JWT_SECRET in production.

properties.name: auth.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Issuer claim (iss) embedded in courier-issued JWTs. Used to route token validation away from Keycloak.

properties.name: auth.jwt.access-token-expiry-seconds
properties.description: Access token TTL in seconds. Default: 900 (15 minutes).

properties.name: auth.jwt.refresh-token-expiry-seconds
properties.description: Refresh token TTL in seconds. Default: 2592000 (30 days).

properties.name: auth.admin.jwt.audience
properties.description: Expected `aud` claim value in Keycloak admin JWTs. Tokens missing this audience are rejected. Must match the Audience mapper configured in Keycloak for the buyology-courier-service client.

properties.name: auth.refresh-token.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the nightly job that purges expired refresh tokens. Defaults to 03:00 server time.

properties.name: management.tracing.sampling.probability
properties.description: Fraction of requests to sample for distributed tracing (0.0–1.0). Use 1.0 in dev, 0.1 in prod.

properties.name: notification.email.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for email notifications. Set to true and supply aws.ses.* credentials.

properties.name: aws.ses.region
properties.description: AWS region where SES is configured (e.g. eu-west-1, us-east-1). Required when notification.email.enabled=true.

properties.name: aws.ses.access-key
properties.description: AWS access key ID with ses:SendEmail permission. Leave blank to use the default credentials provider chain (recommended on AWS infrastructure).

properties.name: aws.ses.secret-key
properties.description: AWS secret access key paired with aws.ses.access-key. Leave blank when using the default credentials provider chain.

properties.name: aws.ses.from-email
properties.description: Verified SES sender email or domain identity shown in the From field of courier emails.

properties.name: aws.ses.from-name
properties.description: Display name shown alongside the from-email in courier emails.

properties.name: aws.ses.configuration-set
properties.description: Optional SES configuration set name to attach to outgoing emails (used for event publishing, dedicated IPs, etc.).
